Hero Portrait Image
-------------------
Place your portrait photo here as:
  public/images/img.webp

This file is referenced in src/components/Hero.tsx:
  src="/images/img.webp"

The image should be a transparent/cutout PNG or WebP of you
against a transparent background (no background), so it
composites cleanly over the blue semicircle backdrop.

Recommended size: 800px wide, 900–1200px tall.
